en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a central square with a statue monument in the foreground, umbrella‑covered market stalls, a tram and pedestrians. Surrounding the square are multi‑storey historic buildings with shop signs in German. In the background, a steep hill rises with fortification walls and a prominent clock tower on top. The printed caption at the bottom reads "KÜNSTLERKARTE" and "GRAZ, HAUPTPLATZ".
